CustomField.description: Lead Freezing Window: the day a channel partner lead moves to the Partnership Queue when no site visit has been done by then. Set when the lead is assigned to the channel partner (Partner Portal Setting: Lead Freeze Days); a grace period the CP Manager approves moves it on.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The day the lead moves to the Partnership Queue if no site visit has been done by then (Lead Freezing Window).
CustomField.label: Freezing Date
